name: ListDetail
summary: A list beside the chosen item's detail, both from the top: an inbox, settings, files, people. It measures the room it is given, not the window: where both don't fit, one shows at a time and the detail has a Back. It only lays out the caller's list and detail; their content, selection and empty states stay theirs. Not for a page's reading column (use PageLayout) or for a side task over the page (use Sheet).
a11y: The list and the detail are labelled regions, the list first in the source as on screen. When one side shows at a time, choosing an item moves focus to the detail (its region, named after the item) and Back returns it to the chosen item, so the keyboard never loses its place. Held heights scroll each side with its own ScrollArea.

props.name: list
props.description: The list: usually a List with `mode="select"` and `selection="single"`, or a navigation of links.

props.name: children
props.description: The chosen item's detail, or an empty state that says to choose one. Starts with the item's heading.

props.name: detailLabel
props.description: Names the detail's region, usually the chosen item's name, e.g. "Ada Lovelace".

props.name: listWidth
props.description: The list's column: `narrow` (18 rem, default) for a name and a short line, `wide` (22 rem) for a name and two lines under it.

props.name: show
props.description: Which side shows when there is room for only one (below the list's column plus 18 rem for the detail). `list` until an item is chosen, then `detail`; Back sets it to `list` again. Where both fit, both show and Back is gone.

props.name: backLabel
props.description: Back's words, naming where it goes, e.g. "Back to messages".

props.name: maxSize
props.description: The most the layout grows before each side scrolls on its own; `fill` takes the height its parent gives it. Without it, both sides grow and the page scrolls.
